_comment: Single source for the README feature table, the website's Features and Modules sections and the module list. Edit this, then run: python3 tools/gen_docs.py

app.name: Dynamic Island
app.tagline: An open-source, privacy-first Dynamic Island for any Android 12+ phone with a punch-hole or notch.

features.title: Invisible at rest
features.summary: Shrinks to exactly your camera hole, with a calibrate mode for a pixel-perfect fit

features.title: Now playing
features.summary: Any music or video app: artwork colour, animated bars, seek progress, play/pause/skip

features.title: Preview, then decide
features.summary: Tap to read the full notification in the island; quick reply inline (with ✨ suggested replies), or open the app

features.title: Calls
features.summary: Answer or decline in the island (phone, WhatsApp, Telegram…), then a live call timer

features.title: Timers & stopwatch
features.summary: From your Clock app or the island's own tools

features.title: Live updates
features.summary: Navigation, deliveries, rides and live scores from any app (Android 16 Live Updates supported)

features.title: Payments
features.summary: Confirmation glimpse for Google Wallet and UPI apps (GPay, PhonePe, Paytm, BHIM, CRED)

features.title: System glimpses
features.summary: Charging, low battery, silent/vibrate, DND, earbuds + battery, airplane mode, offline / back online, hotspot, NFC, unlock, flashlight

features.title: Recording
features.summary: Screen and voice recording with a red REC timer, camera/mic in-use dots

features.title: Island tools
features.summary: Long-press the empty island: 25+ tools you choose and arrange, any app, and shortcuts from your modules

features.title: Notification Inbox
features.summary: Every notification kept (encrypted, on-device) until you clear it: search, filters, OTP copy, ✨ Catch me up

features.title: No double pop-ups
features.summary: Turn off system banners per app, or move notifications into the island; never pops twice

features.title: Make it yours
features.summary: 7 themes, width, height, roundness, opacity, glow outline, animation speed

features.title: Simple app
features.summary: A short first-run setup, then three tabs (Island, Modules, Settings) laid out the way iPhone settings are

features.title: On/off switch
features.summary: Turn the island off and on from the app or a Quick Settings tile; your Inbox keeps working

features.title: Accessible
features.summary: Large-text ready, 48 dp touch targets, TalkBack labels, respects reduced motion and your "time to take action" setting

features.title: Polite
features.summary: Hides an app's activity while that app is open, hides message text on the lock screen, per-app on/off

modules.name: Meeting Notes
modules.summary: Record a meeting from the island or import an audio file: REC timer, live captions, on-device transcript in English, Hindi or Hinglish, playback, AI notes (summary, decisions, action items) and Ask about this meeting.

modules.name: Speech Pack
modules.summary: Hindi and Hinglish speech-to-text on your phone (Meta's Omnilingual ASR) for Meeting Notes, when the phone's own speech recognition can't do Hindi offline. Hindi in Devanagari, English words in Latin letters. Offline after a one-time download.
links: Try it on an audio file

modules.name: AI Engine
modules.summary: A small language model on your phone (Qwen3 or Gemma 4 via LiteRT-LM, or Gemini Nano where available) for meeting notes, Catch me up and reply suggestions. Offline after a one-time download.

modules.name: Calendar
modules.summary: Next meeting countdown, a pop-up 5 minutes before with one-tap Join (Meet, Zoom, Teams, Webex), progress while it runs.

modules.name: Automation Bridge
modules.summary: Tasker, MacroDroid or adb can show cards and tools in the island, protected by a secret key.

modules.name: Updater
modules.summary: Keeps the island and every module up to date from GitHub Releases: checks once a day, shows what's new, and installs only after you tap Update and confirm. Off in Modules means no checks at all.
